# Render — Render for Startups

Four tiers of Render credits valid one year: $500 Prototype (open to all qualified startups), $2,500–$5K Build, $10K–$25K Scale and $100K AI; the Build, Scale and AI tiers require applying through an enrolled accelerator or VC partner.

## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Maximum** | $100,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Upon approval, the credits are automatically applied to your account and you will receive a confirmation email. You will have one year from the date of the confirmation email to use your credits. |
| **When it ends** | Our pricing is always transparent, predictable, and scales with you. You will always keep your existing setup and data, and there are no surprises. |

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Prototype | $500 | $500 in startup credits | No partner needed |
| Build | $5,000 | $5K in credits for startups from select partners | A partner code is required |
| Scale | $25,000 | $25K in startup credits for startups with $1M in funding or more | A partner code is required |
| AI | $100,000 | At least $2.5M in funding from enrolled top tier VC | A partner code is required |

### Not covered

- Series B and later companies ('Pre-Series B')
- Existing Render customers ('New customer')

### Notes

VENDOR SELF-CONTRADICTION on the Build tier: the tier card lists two figures, '$2,500 in credits for startups from a partner' and '$5K in credits for startups from select partners', while the FAQ states 'The majority of VCs and accelerators qualify for our Build tier and $5k in credits.' The more conservative tier-card wording is recorded — assume $2,500 unless your partner is a 'select' one. All four tiers share the eligibility floor/ceiling recorded at top level (new customer, seed funding min $25K, less than 5 years in operation, raised less than $100M, Pre-Series B). Tier amounts are NOT summed. 'Less than 5 years in operation' is not defined as incorporation date, so age_basis is unknown. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
